description:
Froststrap is a fork of Bloxstrap and Fishstrap, focused on performance and customization.


Froststrap v2.0.4 - Bug Fixes
Wasn't hoping for bugs in 2.0.3 but here we are.
Changed
- The UI animation disable toggle is now in the Appearance page.
- Auto-update is now disabled on CI builds. Reinstall manually to move to a newer version.
Fixed
- The Roblox app theme enum not being readable.
